name: tycoonagents
description: Enforces delegation of coding work to cheaper specialist AI models, with a live tycoon-style visualization of that work as it happens.

tycoonagents.autoShow.description: Automatically open the live agent panel when a workspace opens.

tycoonagents.mcp.approveButton.description: Experimental: show a button that approves TycoonAgents' own MCP servers for the current project.

tycoonagents.idleFreezeMinutes.description: Freeze an agent's live time after this many minutes with no activity.

tycoonagents.sanityCapMinutes.description: Hard cap on any single active stretch (minutes).

tycoonagents.themeService.endpoint.description: Advanced: override the Theme Service base URL, https only. Leave empty for the production service.

tycoonagents.powerTools.dir.markdownDescription: Folder holding Trashbyrd's Power Tools (the folder with `uefn-server.mjs`). Leave empty to find it automatically; the `TYCOON_POWER_TOOLS_DIR` environment variable is the same override.

enumDescriptions: OpenCode (Experimental) — new and not yet thoroughly tested.
Codex (Experimental) — new and not yet thoroughly tested.
tycoonagents.provider.description: Which coding agent harness TycoonAgents reads activity from: 'claude-code' watches .claude/tycoon/activity.jsonl written by the Claude Code hook; 'opencode' watches the OpenCode harness's activity log instead. The TYCOON_PROVIDER environment variable, if set, always overrides this setting.

tycoonagents.agents.multiProvider.description: Show vendor and fallback controls for every agent. Leave off if you use a single AI provider.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build && npm run copy:hookruntime && npm run bundle:designdoc && npm run bundle:themebuilder && npm run bundle:host && npm run check:paths && npm run check:webview && npm run lint && npm run test:python && npm run test:standalone && npm run test:compiled
scripts.build: npm run build:webview && tsc -p . && npm run copy:hookruntime
scripts.build-ext: tsc -p . && npm run copy:hookruntime && npm run bundle:host
scripts.package: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true})" && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/ && npm run verify:vsix-contents
